g.text: FIT · PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT · PART 4.5 OF 5 — PROTECTION & THE TOOLBOX · ARC CLOSE
INSTRUMENT № PE-4.5 · TWO-STAGE HPTA RE-IGNITION SEQUENCER
wake the body. then restart the brain. never both at once. coming off is its own skill.
dose hCG running DURING the cycle so
the testicles never go fully dormant.
testosterone feeds back — loop closes on its own
the longer the ester, the longer you wait
last dose + clearance = SERM start date

svg.text: Stage-1 wake-up may overlap the tail of clearance; the SERM phase waits for a clean runway.

g.text: ~2–3 wks · lights the loop from the BOTTOM
the loop is being driven FROM OUTSIDE.
one 5,000 IU hit spikes aromatase → estrogen →
desensitizes the Leydig cells. small + frequent wins.
one drive bus · only ONE input at a time
run hCG into the SERM window → the brain never gets
its "estrogen is low, make your own LH" cue.
months suppressed — while you believe you're recovering.
~4 wks tapering · lights the loop from the TOP
SERMs → block estrogen feedback → brain reads
"estrogen low" → ramps its OWN GnRH → LH/FSH.
trans-isomer only — drops Clomid's mood/visual sides (4.2)
TAMOXIFEN ~20 → 10 mg/day — where gyno is a concern
TRIPTORELIN — single-shot GnRH agonist · potent · timing-unforgiving · know it exists
it's part of the signal (libido, joints, bone). manage the
rebound — don't crush it with an AI or you blunt recovery.
a bloodwork verdict — not a feelings check
LH & FSH climbed · Test healthy WITHOUT help
→ the loop holds on its own.
LH up · Test lagging → more time / short hCG nudge
LH flat → brain hasn't restarted → reassess w/ physician
THE-NUMBER-IS-THE-BOSS · verify with bloods, not feelings
SUPPORT LAYER — THE FLOOR, NOT THE ENGINE
wired to nothing on the loop · makes the crash manageable · restarts nothing
Tongkat Ali + KSM-66 ashwagandha — LH signalling · cortisol
(the SERM appetite surge is how people go soft · ~80% retention)
training — hold the stimulus, drop volume to match low androgen
GOAL = A CHILD → the one case the two
hCG ~500–1,000 IU EOD + hMG ~75–150 IU EOD
"do you want kids, and when" is a PRE-cycle decision (Part 1)
SERMs (trick it into driving its own)
— and not symmetric. longer suppressed · older · more
aggressive compounds = less complete, slower bounce-back.
some land lower than they started; a few stay on lifelong
TRT — a chosen destination, not an accident.
the surest protection is the restraint that came before PCT.
Stage 1 lights the bottom from outside
Stage 2 lights the top · colour flips self-driven
RESTART TIMELINE — honest durations, but the gravity is the gate, not the calendar
STAGE 2 · RESTART BRAIN (SERM taper) · ~4 wks — loop now SELF-DRIVEN
HOLD & VERIFY · bloods at ~4–6 wks post-SERM → RECOVERED?
hCG · hMG · Triptorelin · enclomiphene · tamoxifen = prescription-only. Illustrative ranges, not a protocol. Harm-reduction education, not medical advice.
